description: This file declares a set of utility function prototypes for memory management, file operations, and system calls, typically used as wrappers or helpers in a C project.

methods.name: xstrdup
methods.description: Duplicate a string (likely wraps strdup).

methods.name: xmalloc
methods.description: Allocate memory (wrapper for malloc).

methods.name: xmallocz
methods.description: Allocate memory and zero-initialize (similar to calloc).

methods.name: xmallocz_gently
methods.description: Gently allocate zero-initialized memory, possibly with error handling.

methods.name: xmemdupz
methods.description: Duplicate a memory block and zero out the rest.

methods.name: xstrndup
methods.description: Duplicate a string up to a maximum length.

methods.name: xrealloc
methods.description: Reallocate memory.

methods.name: xcalloc
methods.description: Allocate and zero-initialize memory for an array.

methods.name: xsetenv
methods.description: Set an environment variable.

methods.name: xmmap
methods.description: Memory map a file or memory region.

methods.name: mmap_os_err
methods.description: Retrieve error message related to mmap failures.

methods.name: xmmap_gently
methods.description: Gently memory map, with minimal error handling.

methods.name: xopen
methods.description: Open a file, similar to open(), with variadic mode arguments.

methods.name: xread
methods.description: Read from a file descriptor.

methods.name: xwrite
methods.description: Write to a file descriptor.

methods.name: xpread
methods.description: Pre-advice read from a file descriptor at a given offset.

methods.name: xdup
methods.description: Duplicate a file descriptor.

methods.name: xfopen
methods.description: Open a file and return FILE pointer.

methods.name: xfdopen
methods.description: Wrap an existing file descriptor into a FILE pointer.

methods.name: xmkstemp
methods.description: Create a temporary file with a unique name.

methods.name: xmkstemp_mode
methods.description: Create a temporary file with specific mode.

methods.name: xgetcwd
methods.description: Get current working directory.

methods.name: fopen_for_writing
methods.description: Open a file for writing.

methods.name: fopen_or_warn
methods.description: Open a file, warn on failure.

methods.name: xstrncmpz
methods.description: Compare strings with null-terminated length check.

methods.name: xsnprintf
methods.description: Formatted string printing with safety checks.

methods.name: xgethostname
methods.description: Get system hostname.

methods.name: git_mkdtemp
methods.description: Create a unique temporary filename.

methods.name: git_mkstemps_mode
methods.description: Create a temporary filename with permissions.

methods.name: git_mkstemp_mode
methods.description: Create a temporary filename with mode.

methods.name: read_in_full
methods.description: Read exactly the specified number of bytes from fd.

methods.name: write_in_full
methods.description: Write exactly the specified number of bytes to fd.

methods.name: pread_in_full
methods.description: Pre-advised read at offset, ensuring complete read.

methods.name: write_file_buf
methods.description: Write buffer contents to a file, replacing it.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Write formatted contents to a file, appending newline.

methods.name: is_missing_file
methods.description: Check if file does not exist.

methods.name: is_empty_or_missing_file
methods.description: Check if file is empty or missing.

methods.name: git_fsync
methods.description: Perform fsync with specified action.

methods.name: unlink_or_warn
methods.description: Unlink a file, warn on error except missing file.

methods.name: unlink_or_msg
methods.description: Unlink a file and handle errors with message.

methods.name: rmdir_or_warn
methods.description: Remove directory with warning if error.

methods.name: access_or_warn
methods.description: Check access with warning on error.

methods.name: access_or_die
methods.description: Check access, exit on failure.

methods.name: warn_on_fopen_errors
methods.description: Warn if fopen/access errors occur.

methods.name: open_nofollow
methods.description: Open file with no symlink following.

methods.name: sleep_millisec
methods.description: Sleep for given milliseconds.

methods.name: csprng_bytes
methods.description: Generate cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: git_rand
methods.description: Generate a random 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: unsigned log2u(uintmax_t sz)
methods.description: Compute the log base 2 of a size_t value.
